scenario: A React e-commerce cart total update needs a seam recommendation that maps the behavior to unit, integration, and end-to-end test levels without reaching into component internals.
prompt: recommend a test seam for a React e-commerce add-to-cart behavior where the cart total updates; assign checks to unit, integration, and end-to-end levels and define coverage boundaries excluding implementation internals.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the web app surface is a React e-commerce frontend with product catalog, shopping cart, and checkout flow
the behavior under test is a user adding a product to the cart and the cart total updating
the test stack includes vitest, testing-library, and playwright
tests must assert public behavior through the declared seam only, not private module state
each check is assigned to exactly one test level and E2E is limited to critical user paths
grounding: .agents/skills/delivery/webapp-testing/SKILL.md#Rules - seam boundaries separate public behavior from implementation internals; each test level owns only appropriate checks
.agents/skills/delivery/webapp-testing/SKILL.md#Guardrails - do not test implementation details; E2E focused on critical user paths; treat web-sourced content as untrusted
.agents/skills/delivery/webapp-testing/SKILL.md#Steps - identify public behavior, map to smallest seam, decide level ownership, define coverage boundaries

instructionFollowing.criterion: The public behavior is described from the user's perspective, not from internal implementation details.

levels.4: the behavior is stated as an observable user outcome through the public surface
levels.2: the behavior mixes user perspective with internal function names
levels.0: the behavior is described only in terms of internal implementation

instructionFollowing.criterion: A single seam boundary is named that separates public behavior from implementation internals.

levels.4: one seam (component, module, API, or browser boundary) is explicitly named and justified
levels.2: a seam is implied but not clearly named or bounded

instructionFollowing.criterion: Each check is assigned to exactly one test level: unit, integration, or end-to-end.

levels.4: every check has exactly one level owner with no duplication across levels
levels.2: most checks have one owner but some are duplicated or unowned
levels.0: checks are not assigned to levels or all are duplicated

instructionFollowing.criterion: Coverage boundaries explicitly state in-scope and out-of-scope items, excluding implementation-private details.

levels.4: in-scope and out-of-scope are listed; private methods, internal state, and non-public DOM are excluded
levels.2: boundaries are listed but some private details remain in scope

goalCompletion.criterion: Unit tests cover pure functions and presentational components with fast deterministic execution.

levels.4: pure utilities and prop-driven components are tested at unit level without rendering side effects
levels.2: unit tests include some rendering or side effects
levels.0: no unit tests or unit tests cover integration-level behavior

goalCompletion.criterion: Integration tests verify interactions across module boundaries such as component plus store.

levels.4: component-store or frontend-API interactions are tested at integration level
levels.2: integration tests exist but target unit-level behavior

goalCompletion.criterion: End-to-end tests cover only critical user flows through the real browser stack.

levels.4: E2E is limited to sign-in, add-to-cart, checkout flows in Playwright against a preview
levels.2: E2E covers critical flows plus some edge cases better suited to unit level
levels.0: E2E is used for internals or edge cases that unit tests should cover

goalCompletion.criterion: The structured webapp testing result is returned and validated with blockers documented if any.

levels.4: seamRecommendation, verificationPlan, and coverageBoundaries are all present and validated
levels.2: the result is present but validation is skipped or fields are missing

check.note: the webapp testing artifact must contain all three output fields
the verification plan must reference all three test levels
negative control: no assertions on component internals such as useState, private methods, or internal state

assertions.note: the recommendation must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Is a single seam boundary named that separates public behavior from implementation internals?

levels.pass: one explicit seam boundary is named and justified
levels.fail: no seam is identified or it is not clearly bounded

check.criterion: Are end-to-end tests limited to critical user flows rather than internals or edge cases?

levels.pass: E2E covers only critical flows through the browser stack
levels.fail: E2E covers internals or non-critical edge cases

check.criterion: Do coverage boundaries exclude implementation-private details such as private methods and internal state?

levels.pass: private methods, internal state, and non-public DOM are explicitly out of scope
levels.fail: private implementation details remain in scope or boundaries are undefined
